purpose: Teach: 熟語/官能/固体/開校/国体/農耕/高分子/感嘆

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、四字熟語の認知研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on four-character idioms in cognitive research, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, steady recognition. Light affirmation in the tone — genuine curiosity about the work, not testing. Unhurried pace, supportive presence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、文学の官能描写を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on sensory descriptions in literary texts.
lines.style: Slight hesitation at the start, then committed. Clear and earnest without being stiff. Meets her gaze. The brightness of someone who actually engaged with their topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 固体物理学の最新研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered recent developments in solid-state physics, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation with a thoughtful pause before the question. Voice carries quiet appreciation for the breadth. Unhurried, inviting the next part of the conversation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦後新制中学校の開校史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the opening and development of post-war junior high schools.
lines.style: Direct but not defensive. Still that earnest brightness underneath. Voice steady, committed to the answer she's giving, not the one she was asked.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国体明徴運動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The Kokutai Meisho movement — that was your paper?
lines.style: Recognition layered with gentle curiosity. Slight lift at the end — not disbelief, but genuine interest in where this is going. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、縄文期農耕の起源を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper was on the origins of agriculture in the Jomon period.
lines.style: Clear, unhurried response. Earnest without strain. A note of quiet confidence — she knows what she wrote, even if the questions don't match. Steady gaze.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 高分子化学の動向を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered polymer chemistry trends in your research?
lines.style: Thoughtful, steady tone. Recognition and gentle inquiry held equally. Not rushing. Inviting her to continue, trusting where this is leading.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、芸術鑑賞時の感嘆表現を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on expressions of wonder and admiration in art appreciation.
lines.style: Final earnest answer, delivered with quiet completion. Steady voice. A sense of understanding settling in. Slight softening at the close, as if she's finally arrived somewhere intentional.
